_comment: Generated by boot/composition.mounts.characterisation.test.js (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1) from the real server/index.js, loaded by boot/compositionMounts.testkit.cjs through auth/routeWalk.cli.js. `app` is the stack of the Express app, one entry per app.use() call, app-level route or stray layer; `ai` the use() calls of the /ai router. Recorded with NODE_ENV=production (agent-hub/dist faked present, so the static mounts and the SPA fallback are in it) and every mount switch in its default state: STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED, AUTOMATION_MCP_ENABLED, CMS_MCP_ENABLED, SEARCH_ROUTER_ENABLED and WEBPAGE_FULL_RUNTIME_ENABLED unset. `mcpOn` is the app stack with the three MCP switches set to 1. Mounts made after listen() (the webpage full-tier proxy) are not recorded. Per chain function: kind (router | gate | fn), name, the route-contract class (auth/routeContract.js chainClass), the gate tag; a router carries the count and a sha256 prefix of its sorted "METHOD path" table. `pos` is the position; the test compares the multiset and the relative order of overlapping paths, not positions. Routes: auth/routes.contract.json.
